answer.book: A 1612 volume of chymical treatises by Nicolaus Niger Hapelius (Eglinus) containing six works, each with its own title page, front matter (prefaces, dedications) and chapters or questions: Cheiragogia Heliana, Tractatus de coelo terrestri, Disquisitio Heliana, Aphorismi Basiliani, Basis fidei, and Cabalae verior descriptio.
